items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Buddy and Al Viola and Al Aarons and Grover Mitchell and Leroy Vinnegar had a label together. He did our album covers for us.

ctx.x: Before we go any further, I would like to go back to March 5th. I left out one guy, one of the most important ones, Al Viola, who played a wonderful rendition of "Send In The Clowns" on his beautiful Classical guitar. It was another highlight of our performance.
It certainly was. I was very, very impressed.
